welcome.welcome.title: Welcome to POKIT
welcome.welcome.body: A lightweight app to collect daily routines and stay focused at your own pace.
welcome.today.title: Collect and continue today
welcome.today.body: Gather today’s routines and review your day in a clear list.
welcome.routines.title: Create and group routines
welcome.routines.body: Build frequently used routines and bundle them for quick reuse throughout the day.
welcome.modes.title: Notes, todos, and reading in one place
welcome.modes.body: Take quick notes, organize todos, and manage reading goals in one app.
welcome.next.title: Track progress and dive deeper anytime
welcome.next.body: Completed routines are saved in History.
welcome.next.note: You can explore with “Try POKIT quickly” on Today, or open Settings → User guide anytime.
tour.pokitWeek.listHint: Tap an item for a tip. “Got it” checks it off. You can finish them all in one go.
tour.pokitWeek.step1.title: Browse the Routines tab
tour.pokitWeek.step1.body: Open the Routines tab to explore health, focus, and daily routines. You can also recolor groups like sticky notes.
tour.pokitWeek.step2.title: Create your own routine
tour.pokitWeek.step2.body: In My Routines, tap “+” to make a routine of your own. You can add it to Today or fixed routines later.
tour.pokitWeek.step3.title: Check History
tour.pokitWeek.step3.body: Open the History tab to review what you finished. Small logs add up into habits.
tour.pokitWeek.step4.title: Try the todo list
tour.pokitWeek.step4.body: Use the header icon on Today to open the todo list. Keep light tasks separate from routines.
tour.pokitWeek.step5.title: Open the bookstore
tour.pokitWeek.step5.body: Switch to Reading mode up top. Add books you want to read and track progress.
tour.pokitWeek.step6.title: Write a lock-screen memo
tour.pokitWeek.step6.body: Open Lock-screen memo mode up top. Leave a short note you’ll see on the lock screen.
tour.pokitWeek.step7.title: Write a note
tour.pokitWeek.step7.body: Open Note mode up top and jot a day’s thought. When this chapter’s checks are done, explore the rest at your pace.

guideBook.page.cover.title: Bottom tabs
guideBook.page.cover.lead: POKIT splits your day across five bottom tabs.
guideBook.page.cover.c1.detail: See today’s bag, focus window, and the daily line next to the date.
guideBook.page.cover.c2.detail: Create and manage routines in post-it bundles.
guideBook.page.cover.c3.detail: Expand daily, weekend, and your groups, then Apply to today.
guideBook.page.cover.c4.detail: Review completions and focus by week or month.
guideBook.page.cover.c5.detail: Read articles and save them as routines.
guideBook.page.chrome.title: Top modes & settings
guideBook.page.chrome.lead: Above Today you’ll find mode switches and Settings.
guideBook.page.chrome.c1.detail: The default mode with today’s bag and list.
guideBook.page.chrome.c2.detail: Write a short memo for the lock screen.
guideBook.page.chrome.note1: Modes only change the Today experience—they’re not the bottom tabs.
guideBook.page.today-overview.title: Today tab screen
guideBook.page.today-overview.lead: Stack routines for today and view them as a list in your focus window. A daily encouragement line also sits next to the date.
guideBook.page.today-overview.c1.label: Date · focus window
guideBook.page.today-overview.c1.detail: Shows today’s date and day start–end (focus window). Tap the times to change them.
guideBook.page.today-overview.c2.label: Quote of the day
guideBook.page.today-overview.c2.detail: A different encouragement line each day appears beside the date. Use copy or share to send it elsewhere.
guideBook.page.today-overview.c3.label: List · todos
guideBook.page.today-overview.c3.detail: List and todo icons on the header right. Todo opens the task screen.
guideBook.page.today-overview.c4.label: Stack area
guideBook.page.today-overview.c4.detail: When empty, you see empty-stack hints and Add routine.
guideBook.page.today-overview.c5.label: Bottom Today tab
guideBook.page.today-overview.note1: On first launch, set day start/end in onboarding, then tap Get started. Later, change them in Settings → Day start/end and tap Save.
guideBook.page.today-overview.note2: The daily line stays the same for that day and changes when the date changes.
guideBook.page.today-window.title: Focus window \u00b7 date
guideBook.page.today-window.lead: Header time and date define the scope of \u201ctoday.\u201d
guideBook.page.today-window.c1.label: Focus window time
guideBook.page.today-window.c1.detail: Opens start/end pickers. Adjust midnight, AM/PM, and next-day spans.
guideBook.page.today-window.c2.label: Apply
guideBook.page.today-window.c2.detail: Applies times chosen on Today and closes. (In Settings the same UI uses Save.)
guideBook.page.today-window.c3.label: Same day / next day
guideBook.page.today-window.c3.detail: If end is before start, the day spans into the next calendar day.
guideBook.page.today-window.c4.label: Effective range
guideBook.page.today-window.c4.detail: Pick start/end dates on the calendar with Today, Reset, and Apply.
guideBook.page.today-layouts.title: List view
guideBook.page.today-layouts.lead: See stacked routines in a single list.
guideBook.page.today-layouts.c1.label: List
guideBook.page.today-layouts.c1.detail: View stacked routines in one list. Add with Add routine / Add more routines.
guideBook.page.today-layouts.c2.label: Todo shortcut
guideBook.page.today-layouts.c2.detail: Todo icon next to the list icon opens the task screen.
guideBook.page.today-add-row.title: Add routines and row actions
guideBook.page.today-add-row.lead: After adding with Add routine, expand a row or tap buttons to manage it right away.
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c1.label: Add / link routines
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c1.detail: Pick multiple at once. Create a new template-based routine from the picker too.
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c2.label: Priority
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c2.detail: Cycle high → medium → low. High and low also tint the row background.
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c3.label: Mark complete
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c3.detail: A black circle with a mint checkmark shows complete. Tap again to undo.
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c4.label: Expand row · settings
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c4.detail: The chevron opens a note-style panel for summary, time, and template controls. The slider opens full goal-detail settings.
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c5.label: Long-press · remove
guideBook.page.today-add-row.c5.detail: With 2+ items, long-press to reorder. After focus starts, Remove drops the item from today’s stack.
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.title: Auto focus \u00b7 window end
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.lead: Today has no separate Start button\u2014your stack and focus window are what matter.
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.c1.label: Stacking starts focus
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.c1.detail: Adding a routine to the stack auto-starts focus on Today.
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.c2.label: When the window ends
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.c2.detail: Stack and focus state reset; unfinished flows may close and appear in History.
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.c3.label: Keep stack
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.c3.detail: Settings \u2192 Day start/end \u2192 Keep stack after day ends keeps items longer.
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.c4.label: Apply integration
guideBook.page.today-autofocus.c4.detail: With Apply on in My routines, changes reflect in today\u2019s stack and window.
guideBook.page.routine-list.title: Routine list
guideBook.page.routine-list.lead: Create and organize routines in post-it bundles here. Apply them to today from the My routines tab.
guideBook.page.routine-list.c1.label: List / templates
guideBook.page.routine-list.c1.detail: List is for create/manage; templates preview layout styles.
guideBook.page.routine-list.c2.label: + button
guideBook.page.routine-list.c2.detail: Choose New routine or New bundle from What would you like to create?
guideBook.page.routine-list.c3.label: Post-it bundles
guideBook.page.routine-list.c3.detail: Tap a bundle header to expand. Only the top bundle starts open; pick a post-it color inside when expanded.
guideBook.page.routine-list.c4.label: Items \u00b7 edit bundles
guideBook.page.routine-list.c4.detail: Tap an item for its detail settings. Edit or delete bundles; move, hide, or delete items depending on type.
guideBook.page.routine-list.note1: City-pop illustrations behind the screen are decorative only and don’t affect taps.
guideBook.page.routine-templates.title: Routine templates
guideBook.page.routine-templates.lead: Cards open a note-style preview. The same templates are used when creating routines and in Today’s expanded rows.
guideBook.page.routine-templates.c1.deta: Check off tasks one by one. You can also edit them from an expanded Today row.
guideBook.page.routine-templates.c3.deta: Pick a metric, then type a number or use ±—it saves right away. There is no separate Save record button.
guideBook.page.routine-templates.c4.deta: Fill a target count with −/+. Preset chips quickly set the name and goal.
guideBook.page.routine-templates.c5.deta: Check off each scheduled time. Previews are not saved.
guideBook.page.my-routine.title: My routines screen
guideBook.page.my-routine.lead: Daily, weekend, and your groups stack as post-its. Use Apply on each group for today’s stack.
guideBook.page.my-routine.c1.label: Post-it list
guideBook.page.my-routine.c1.detail: Groups stack like post-its. Only the top group starts expanded; tap a header to open or close.
guideBook.page.my-routine.c2.label: Daily \u00b7 weekend fixed
guideBook.page.my-routine.c2.detail: Daily fixed (every day) and Weekend fixed (Sat·Sun) are built in. Names cannot be changed.
guideBook.page.my-routine.c3.label: Your groups
guideBook.page.my-routine.c3.detail: Custom groups you create. Add with + or Add group; rename or delete from the header.
guideBook.page.my-routine.c4.label: Apply
guideBook.page.my-routine.c4.detail: Group header Apply adds enabled items to today’s stack. Shows Applying when on; tap again to turn off.
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.title: Expand \u00b7 Apply
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.lead: Expand a group, set color and items, then tap Apply to reflect them in today’s stack.
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.c1.label: Expand \u00b7 post-it color
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.c1.detai: Tap the header to expand the body. Color chips appear only when expanded.
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.c2.label: Enable \u00b7 add items
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.c2.detai: Use switches to pick items; configure with Add new item.
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.c3.label: Apply
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.c3.detai: Header Apply puts enabled items into today’s stack. When it shows Applying, tap again to turn off.
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.note1: When the focus window ends, Apply is dimmed and shows Focus time has ended. Adjust focus time on Today, then apply again.
guideBook.page.my-routine-apply.note2: With Weekend apply on, items auto-appear on Today on Sat and Sun.
guideBook.page.history.title: History
guideBook.page.history.lead: Review completed routines and focus by week or month.
guideBook.page.history.c1.label: Weekly / Monthly
guideBook.page.history.c1.detail: Switch between weekly and monthly views at the top.
guideBook.page.history.c2.label: Move period
guideBook.page.history.c2.detail: Use the arrows to go to the previous or next week (or month).
guideBook.page.history.c3.label: Weekly summary
guideBook.page.history.c3.detail: See this week’s summary, stats, and top routines.
guideBook.page.history.c4.label: Per-routine card
guideBook.page.history.c4.detail: Open each routine’s card for more detail.
guideBook.page.history.note1: Background art and card styling are there to make your records easier to browse.
guideBook.page.story.title: Story
guideBook.page.story.lead: Read web articles and save what you like as a routine.
guideBook.page.story.c1.label: Story article
guideBook.page.story.c1.detail: Scroll and read the web body.
guideBook.page.story.c2.label: Title · category
guideBook.page.story.c2.detail: Choose the title and routine category to save.
guideBook.page.story.c3.label: Save to routine
guideBook.page.story.c3.detail: Saves the selection as a routine.
guideBook.page.settings.title: Settings
guideBook.page.settings.lead: Focus window, typeface, guide, support, and data—all in one place.
guideBook.page.settings.c1.label: Start & wind-down
guideBook.page.settings.c1.detail: Change Today’s focus window (start and end times).
guideBook.page.settings.c2.label: User guide
guideBook.page.settings.c3.label: Text size · typeface
guideBook.page.settings.c3.detail: Choose Small / Default / Large and a typeface like City Pop Dongle.
guideBook.page.settings.c4.label: Support · version
guideBook.page.settings.c4.detail: Contact support and check the app version.
guideBook.page.settings.c5.label: Reset data
guideBook.page.settings.c5.detail: Use this when you want to start the app data from scratch.
